# Memmy v1.2.6

## Highlights

- Fixed repeated escaping in Windows launch-at-login commands and repaired legacy entries while preserving disabled startup preferences.
- Improved Memory management responsiveness, filtered browsing, detail loading, and recovery from temporary read failures.
- Improved background processing fairness, retry scheduling, scan recovery, and responsiveness to new real-time tasks.

## Memory improvements

- Added per-turn task and feedback judgment and expanded capture summaries to 300 characters.
- Preserved historical memory relationships during turn migration and deduplicated recalled sources.
- Strengthened project boundaries and retained deleted world-model fields across scans and imports.
- Preserved owner boundaries for nonlocal memory reads and deletes, including task data and linked records.

## Agent and Desktop improvements

- Preserved Computer Use authorization through eligible Goal continuations.
- Improved Markdown, LaTeX, generated-file links, and attachment handling; reasoning paths use display-only inline code.
- Hide the Knowledge sidebar while the service is unavailable.

## Upgrade notes

- Memmy Desktop and Agent use version `1.2.6`. The Memory service, viewer, and CLI remain independently versioned at `2.1.7`.
- Existing malformed Windows startup entries are repaired when the updated desktop app is opened. Disabled or absent startup entries are not enabled by this repair.
- Installation, in-place upgrade, signed-package validation, and publication remain separate release checks.
